summary: This is one VivaCity camera on the western path of a Parramatta bridge, with four zones: the main path, the stairs, and the left and right paths. The main path and right path zones see the same riders (often identical slots), and this makes the repeated bursts of false detections in darkness easy to spot: at the main path in 2023-2025, the right path in Feb-Mar 2024 and the left path in a few nights, these are set missing; from 28 May 2025 the main path zone fails outright (first undercounting, then thousands of false counts a week) until it stops reporting on 23 Aug 2025. The stairs zone carries almost no bikes, so its zeros are restored; from Feb 2025 the feed publishes no zero slots, so days look incomplete, but the published counts look genuine.
